title: Very Cute!
text: Very Cute!. I ordered the small size as this is meant to be decor for my ottoman, and it is perfect. No noticeable imperfections and the only issue I have is the flowers. They came bent from packaging and are very cheaply made so I will be replacing with better ones, but otherwise this is too cute and well worth the $$.
